g.text: Soft-RoCE: ten paired process blocks per workload
One server/client binary and object per cell; AB/BA order alternates. Dots are launched process blocks, not individual reads.
Intervals resample ten paired blocks (20,000 seeded draws); VM/RXE software results, not physical HCA aggregation.
